subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Who Gets Targeted Most
description: Learn Who Gets Targeted Most in one minute.

hook.text: The elderly and children are the most targeted — because their identities are least monitored.

buildup.text: Children's Social Security numbers are clean slates. Fraud can go undetected for years.

discovery.text: Seniors are targeted because they often have good credit and may not check statements closely.

twist.text: Military personnel deployed overseas are also prime targets — they can't monitor accounts easily.

climax.text: Identity thieves don't target wealth. They target vulnerability and inattention.

punchline.text: The best target is someone who won't notice for years.

quiz.question: Why are children common targets of identity theft?
options: Their identities are unmonitored for years
